skill.description: Create platform-specific captions, on-screen text, hashtags, CTAs, and pinned comments for short-form video. The skill helps avoid engagement bait, hashtag stuffing, repeated hooks, and weak calls to action.

content.value_statement: Short-form creators need captions and CTAs that support reach without engagement bait. This skill creates platform-specific captions, hashtags, on-screen text, and pinned comments.
actual_capabilities: Writes captions for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts with visible-line cutoff guidance.
Selects one primary CTA based on content type, audience goal, and platform behavior.
Recommends 3 to 5 niche hashtags and rejects generic filler tags or hashtag walls.
Produces on-screen text specs with headline copy, caption rhythm, safe zones, font, and contrast guidance.
Suggests pinned comments or first comments that answer objections, add context, or carry useful links.
Checks draft copy for engagement-bait patterns and rewrites safer alternatives.
limitations: It does not guarantee virality or specific performance results.
It depends on the user brief for platform, topic, audience, and goal.
It cannot analyze private analytics unless the user supplies relevant data.
Platform rules, UI placement, and algorithm behavior can change after the skill content was written.

use_cases.title: Launch a Short-Form Post
use_cases.description: Create a caption, hashtag set, CTA, and pinned comment for one TikTok, Reel, or Short.

use_cases.title: Fix Engagement-Bait Copy
use_cases.description: Diagnose weak CTAs such as comment triggers, multi-ask closers, or generic follow requests, then rewrite them.

use_cases.title: Adapt Copy Across Platforms
use_cases.description: Rewrite one video concept for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts with native caption and hashtag rules.

prompt_templates.title: Write One Caption
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a caption for a [platform] video about [topic]. The audience is [audience], and the goal is [save, send, comment, or click]. Include 3 to 5 hashtags and one pinned comment.

prompt_templates.title: Fix My CTA
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a weak or bait-shaped call to action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this CTA for engagement bait: [paste CTA]. Keep the same business goal, then rewrite three safer versions for saves, sends, and comments.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Copy Pack
prompt_templates.scenario: Create the complete text layer for a video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full copy pack for a [length] [platform] video about [topic]. Include visible caption line, body caption, hashtags, CTA timing, pinned comment, and on-screen headline.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this short-form video copy for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts: [paste draft]. Use native cutoffs, SEO terms, CTA placement, hashtags, and pinned-comment strategy for each platform.

output_examples.input: A 45-second Instagram Reel about stopping retinol flaking for sensitive skin.
output: Caption: The reason your retinol is peeling your face may be the routine around it. Send this to your friend who keeps blaming the brand.
Pinned comment: Day 14 update: still no flaking, and I did not lower the strength.

output_examples.input: CTA draft: Comment YES for my free content calendar.
output: Verdict: Bait-shaped, because it asks for the act of commenting to unlock the payoff.
Rewrite: The content calendar is in the pinned comment. Save it before you plan next week.
Alternative: Send this to the person who always asks what to post on Monday.

output_examples.input: A YouTube Short that teases a longer video about budget espresso machines.
output: Title: The best espresso machine under $300 surprised me
Description opening: I tested three budget espresso machines. The cheapest one handled milk drinks better than expected.
CTA: Full breakdown of the pressure test is on the channel.

best_practices: Give the platform, audience, topic, and primary action before asking for final copy.
Use one CTA per video, matched to the strongest natural viewer action.
Place the primary keyword early in the caption, on-screen text, and voiceover.
anti_patterns: Do not stack like, save, share, follow, and comment requests in one close.
Do not use generic hashtags such as #viral, #fyp, or broad 30-tag walls.
Do not repeat the on-screen hook as the written caption without adding context.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee a viral post?
faq.answer: No. It applies proven copy patterns, but results depend on the video, audience, timing, and platform behavior.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It covers Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, including caption cutoffs, hashtags, CTAs, and pinned comments.

faq.question: Can it rewrite my existing caption?
faq.answer: Yes. Paste the draft and share the platform, goal, audience, and any brand voice rules.

faq.question: Will it help avoid engagement bait?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags bait-shaped phrases and rewrites them into save, send, comment, or watch-to-end prompts.

faq.question: Does it create on-screen text?
faq.answer: Yes. It can specify headline copy, body caption timing, safe zones, fonts, size, contrast, and keyword alignment.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
